package.title: Property Predator introduction

borrower_fee.description: 1% of the modelled initial gross loan, minimum £995 when a positive initial loan is modelled. Written engagement terms and VAT treatment require confirmation.

conditions: The initial review is free and does not instruct brokerage work or trigger a fee.
Written terms must settle instruction, fee basis, payment trigger and timing, cancellation, refunds and clawback before a charge or introducer payment.
VAT treatment and introducer payee eligibility remain unconfirmed.
Lender-paid commission is not configured; its amount is unknown, not confirmed zero.
Any original introducer is recorded separately; referral attribution does not establish entitlement or permit overlapping automatic payouts.

warnings: Incomplete cost confirmation: every applicable tax, VAT, professional, legal, monitoring, broker, holding and exit cost must be checked. Zero examples are not confirmed free services.
This illustration is not a lender quote, eligibility decision or approval. All six routes require broker scope review.
The initial review is free. No fee is charged and no introducer commission is earned by using the calculator or transferring an enquiry.
VAT treatment is unreviewed. No VAT is provisionally added; this does not confirm exemption or a final payable amount.
Lender-paid commission is unknown and not configured. Any later lender remuneration and relevant disclosures require separate confirmation.
Payment timing is an illustration assumption: the broker fee is allowed for upfront in the cash projection. Actual collection, cancellation and refund terms need written agreement.
assumptions: All starting numbers are synthetic MH196 planning examples dated 25 October 2026, not live rates or approved lender criteria.
Costs must be checked for the actual transaction, including taxes and irrecoverable VAT; no tax or fee entitlement is inferred.
Planning estimate — not a lender quote or approval. No application, quote, borrowing or lender approach is created.
Purchase price is current acquisition cash. Already-owned property uses zero purchase price, current value and existing debt; historic project basis and owned-land LTC contributions are not modelled.
Planning estimate — not a lender quote or approval. All inputs are illustrative or user supplied; no lender relationship, eligibility, criteria approval or availability is implied.
GBP only. Net initial advance is after upfront finance deductions, before existing debt redemption and project cash costs; net completion cash additionally deducts existing debt.
All monetary outputs are penny-rounded strings. Requested funding and any constrained funding shortfall remain visible. No case is stored and no lender, AI or email service is contacted.

Purchase price means cash paid for acquisition in this scenario, never a historic cost. For already-owned property use zero purchase price, current value and existing debt; historic equity/cost basis is outside this model and cannot establish whole-project profit or an owned-land LTC contribution.
BTL requested/available borrowing is gross debt including any financed product fee; both rental and LTV caps apply to that debt.
BTL product fee is a percentage of the advance excluding a financed fee; financed fees reduce cash proceeds within the gross debt cap.
BTL interest-only payments use the pay rate. Rental capacity uses max(stress floor, pay rate + stress margin), without inferring a fixed-rate product.
BTL works, contingency and project costs are cash-funded at completion. No future sale or repayment of the ongoing BTL loan is modelled.
BTL cash left invested is the signed cumulative cash shortfall after the projection's net rental cash flows; a negative number is released cash, not project profit.
Package fee replaces borrower_broker_fee rather than adding to it; the resulting amount appears once in total_finance_cost and the cash projection.
Fee basis is the actual modelled gross initial advance after lending caps, not the requested advance, staged works, rolled interest or a later refinance loan.
For BTL the initial gross loan includes a financed product fee. The illustration does not establish a contractual fee denominator.
Introducer percentages use borrower fee income excluding VAT for this illustration. Lender-paid components are deferred; no future lender fee share is promised.
